description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定订阅通道所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the subscription channel resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：

- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> 默认取值为**Forward**。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> Default value: **Forward**.

description.zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeSynchronizationJobs**接口查询。
description.en: Instance ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the **DescribeSynchronizationJobs** operation to query instance ID.

title.zh: 查询同步作业的监控报警
title.en: Query monitoring and alerting settings of a synchronization task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-synchronization-job-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id kxz1170c10p0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeSynchronizationJobAlert --region cn-hangzhou --SynchronizationJobId kxz1170c10p0000 --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
